data.hypothesis: Binary decomposition of the even terminal exponents can replace 64 powf calls per input with a small table of squared powers and bounded products, without the long sequential recurrence tested previously. Double-precision table construction and composition may limit drift, but loop overhead, reciprocals, payoff-boundary sensitivity, and full-call speed remain unmeasured.

memory_lessons.applicability: Useful when evaluating another general power-generation scheme; reported correctness cases do not establish that payoff-boundary inputs were covered.
memory_lessons.claim: The two prior power-generation variants were controller-valid on their eight listed cases. Their full-call means were 0.304658 s for eight powf-seeded recurrence blocks and 0.296868 s for a double-precision centered recurrence; the records contain no failed numerical variant or explicit boundary-coverage evidence.
memory_lessons.next_experiment: Measure this binary-decomposition candidate on varied and near-boundary inputs, then compare full-call timings under the same controller protocol.

data.notes: This is a distinct binary-decomposition candidate, not a measured result. The prior two variants each passed eight reported cases; their means were 0.304658 s and 0.296868 s, versus the 0.390983 s baseline. No failed numerical variant is recorded in the available history, and the listed cases do not establish explicit near-payoff-boundary coverage. The controller must validate this candidate, including boundary-sensitive varied inputs, and measure its full-call time; no speedup is claimed. Only terminal-power generation changes; all 64 exponents, the payoff floor, and rollback remain intact.
transformations: Precompute double-precision powers of u^2 and their reciprocals by repeated squaring.
Generate each of the 64 terminal powers by composing the table entries selected by the magnitude's binary representation, preserving exponents -64 through 62 by twos.
Keep the max(0, X-S*upow) terminal payoff calculation and the existing rollback unchanged.
